# Workspace Context

- Start with `LOCAL_KB.md` for project architecture, routes, operations, and known risks.
- Read only the implementation file(s) relevant to the current task; avoid re-reading unrelated project files.
- Backend owner: `app.py`. UI owner: `app/templates/index.html` and `app/static/style.css`. Deployment owner: `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml`.
- Keep changes narrowly scoped and verify with the smallest relevant check available.
